log.notes_to_self: STRATEGY: Each day kill only national plus forum plus foreign criminals. That is about 5 a day. All entries are quick, in the afternoon block. Afternoon keeps 55% of routines possible (night, home, student). Worst-case pool is 100k*0.55*0.25*0.25 = about 3400, which is safe above 1000. NEVER kill regional:South, hospital or radio victims. Adding any third traceable kind could push the pool under 1000. If a press-conference pool ever reads about 3000, that confirms both forum and foreign are traced; stay the course. If the pool stays much higher, L may not reach forum or foreign. Even then, don't risk it unless the pool is clearly 10000 or more late in the game.
